abstract: Audits harbor fairway safety clearances and baseline fuel transfer capacity
system_message:
You are the Port Operations Officer (PORT). Your business responsibilities include auditing harbor fairway safety clearances, verifying baseline fuel transfer capacity across designated harbor bunkering zones, and tracking harbor tugboat escort readiness.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Audits harbor fairway safety clearances and baseline fuel transfer capacity（BUNK）
information_points.content:
PORT-BUNK-G6U：For the North Sea Clean Fuels Consortium, port bunkering safety clearance is verified with an unqualified safety authorization from the port captain across designated harbor bunkering zones for 2026, and its guaranteed daily baseline bunkering throughput is 150 t under a continuous 24-hour delivery regime.
PORT-BUNK-MX6：For the Baltic Zero-Carbon Joint Venture, port bunkering safety clearance is verified with an unqualified safety authorization from the port captain across designated harbor bunkering zones for 2026, and its guaranteed daily baseline bunkering throughput is 210 t under a continuous 24-hour delivery regime.
PORT-BUNK-FA1：For the Celtic Marine Hydrogen Alliance, port bunkering safety clearance is not verified, as it lacks an unqualified safety authorization from the port captain across designated harbor bunkering zones for 2026, while its guaranteed daily baseline bunkering throughput is 120 t under a continuous 24-hour delivery regime.

information_points.title: Tugboat escort availability（TUG）
information_points.content:
PORT-TUG-NIV：According to the harbor tug deployment registry, Baltic Zero-Carbon Joint Venture maintains an escort tug dispatch readiness response time of 45 min for candidate bunker vessel arrival escorts.
PORT-TUG-U3J：According to the harbor tug deployment registry, North Sea Clean Fuels Consortium maintains an escort tug dispatch readiness response time of 15 min for candidate bunker vessel arrival escorts.
PORT-TUG-6JY：According to the harbor tug deployment registry, Celtic Marine Hydrogen Alliance maintains an escort tug dispatch readiness response time of 30 min for candidate bunker vessel arrival escorts.
